title: RPM-MCTS: Knowledge-Retrieval as Process Reward Model with Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation
authors_zh: Yuanyuan Lin, Xiangyu Ouyang, Teng Zhang, Kaixin Sui
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时轨迹、反馈与选择机制的读者
one_line: RPM-MCTS: Knowledge-Retrieval as Process Reward Model with Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation records thought/tree nodes retrieval scores similarity filter and sandbox feedback under retrieval-as-PRM and execution feedback.
RPM-MCTS 将检索相似度、沙盒反馈与 LLM 判断结合为代码规划树的过程信号。
why: It makes MCTS expansion/filtering/correction and its audit boundary visible for reasoning-data curation.
inclusion_reason: Approved Track 5 candidate with a concrete feedback/selection object: thought/tree nodes retrieval scores similarity filter and sandbox feedback.

title: Problem
问题
html: RPM-MCTS addresses a test-time code-generation bottleneck: tree search can generate alternative plans, but intermediate algorithmic steps are difficult to score and erroneous steps are often detected only after complete code is produced. The paper’s primary reasoning object is a search trace whose root is a programming problem and whose other nodes are algorithmic steps; associated signals include knowledge-retrieval scores, similarity-based pruning decisions, public-test execution results, LLM judgments, error reflections, and the selected final plan and code. The paper also constructs 2.4K reasoning-step samples for supervised fine-tuning, but no official reusable trace or dataset release is linked, so the described runtime object must be distinguished from a publicly available corpus.

RPM-MCTS 面向测试时代码生成中的一个瓶颈：树搜索能够生成候选规划，但中间算法步骤难以评分，错误步骤往往要到完整代码生成后才能被发现。论文的主要推理对象是一条搜索轨迹，其中根节点是编程问题，其余节点是算法步骤；相关信号包括知识检索得分、基于相似度的剪枝决策、公开测试用例执行结果、LLM 判断、错误反思，以及最终选中的规划与代码。论文还构造了 2.4K 条带推理步骤的监督微调样本，但未链接官方可复用的轨迹或数据集发布，因此必须区分论文描述的运行时对象与公开可获得的语料库。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: RPM-MCTS uses retrieval from historically correct algorithmic solutions “as Process Reward Model,” but this is not a separately trained PRM and the retrieval score is not verified step correctness. A node’s selection score combines UCB with the maximum non-negative cosine similarity between the current problem–prefix–candidate-step representation and entries in the knowledge base. Expansion samples multiple next steps and removes overly similar candidates. Simulation completes a plan and code, then combines the public-test pass rate with an LLM evaluation; sandbox feedback and LLM analysis localize an erroneous step, truncate the failing suffix, and add the retained correct prefix back to the tree. MCTS selection and backpropagation allocate search compute using these signals; they do not by themselves establish the quality of any resulting training record.

RPM-MCTS 将历史正确算法解法的检索结果用作“Process Reward Model”，但它并不是单独训练的 PRM，检索得分也不等同于已验证的步骤正确性。节点选择得分由 UCB 与一个检索项组成：对当前“问题—前缀—候选步骤”的表示，在知识库中取最大非负余弦相似度。扩展阶段采样多个下一步并删除相似度过高的候选。模拟阶段补全规划与代码，再组合公开测试用例通过率和 LLM 评价；沙箱反馈与 LLM 分析用于定位错误步骤、截断失败后缀，并把保留的正确前缀加入搜索树。MCTS 的选择与回传利用这些信号分配搜索计算，但其本身不能证明产出的训练记录具有高质量。

title: Method
方法
html:
The knowledge base is built from APPS and CodeContests training problems paired with correct implementations. Claude Sonnet 3.7 generates and decomposes each correct solution into algorithmic steps; the problem and successive step prefixes are embedded with BGE and stored in a vector database organized into 14 algorithm categories. RPM-MCTS then iterates selection, expansion, evaluation/reflection, and backpropagation. The root stores the problem, each action adds an algorithmic-step node, expansion uses sampling plus cosine-similarity filtering, and simulation prompts the LLM to finish the plan and generate code that is run against public tests. The scalar node value is a weighted combination of execution pass rate and LLM evaluation, while reflection attempts to identify the first faulty step and retain the preceding steps.

Experiments use Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-235B-A22B, and Claude Sonnet 3.7, with a maximum of five iterations for all compared search methods, across HumanEval+, MBPP+, APPS, and CodeContests. Separately, RPM-MCTS generates 2.4K code samples with reasoning steps using Doubao-1.5-pro-32K; these are mixed with a 170K foundational dataset for full fine-tuning. The official sources do not link code, the knowledge-base snapshot, complete trees, the 2.4K records, rejected candidates, or replayable sandbox fixtures. Exact decoding seeds, per-record lineage, split and decontamination records, and artifact licenses therefore remain unknown.

知识库由 APPS 和 CodeContests 的训练题目及其正确实现构成。Claude Sonnet 3.7 为每个正确解法生成算法步骤并逐步拆分；问题与连续步骤前缀使用 BGE 嵌入，并按 14 个算法类别存入向量数据库。RPM-MCTS 随后反复执行选择、扩展、评价/反思和回传。根节点保存问题，每个动作增加一个算法步骤节点；扩展阶段采用采样与余弦相似度过滤，模拟阶段提示 LLM 补全规划并生成代码，再用公开测试用例执行。节点标量值是执行通过率与 LLM 评价的加权组合，反思过程则尝试定位第一个错误步骤并保留此前步骤。

实验使用 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 Claude Sonnet 3.7；所有对比搜索方法的最大迭代次数均为 5，并在 HumanEval+、MBPP+、APPS 和 CodeContests 上评测。另一个实验使用 Doubao-1.5-pro-32K，通过 RPM-MCTS 生成 2.4K 条带推理步骤的代码样本，再与 170K 条基础数据混合进行全量微调。官方来源未链接代码、知识库快照、完整搜索树、2.4K 条记录、被拒候选或可重放的沙箱夹具。因此，精确解码随机种子、逐记录血缘、划分与去污染记录以及制品许可仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports system-level evidence rather than record-level validation. Across the four benchmark families, RPM-MCTS improves average pass@1 over the corresponding base models by 11.90% for Qwen3-8B, 7.71% for Qwen3-235B-A22B, and 10.86% for Claude Sonnet 3.7 under the reported protocol. Removing knowledge-base rewards lowers the Qwen3-235B-A22B average by 1.05%, with a 4.67% average drop on APPS-competition and CodeContests; removing execution rewards causes the largest ablation decline. The paper also reports about 15% lower token use than the prior MCTS comparator for Qwen3-235B-A22B and Claude Sonnet 3.7. Fine-tuning Doubao-1.5-pro-32K on the 2.4K RPM-MCTS samples plus 170K foundational samples yields reported gains from 0.9 to 4.9 points across five downstream benchmarks. These results support utility under the tested search and training configurations, but they do not verify every retrieved analogy, reflected prefix, or distilled sample.

论文提供的是系统级证据，而非逐记录验证。在四类基准的报告协议下，RPM-MCTS 相对对应基础模型的平均 pass@1 提升分别为：Qwen3-8B 11.90%、Qwen3-235B-A22B 7.71%、Claude Sonnet 3.7 10.86%。移除知识库奖励后，Qwen3-235B-A22B 的平均结果下降 1.05%，在 APPS-competition 与 CodeContests 上平均下降 4.67%；移除执行奖励造成最大的消融退化。论文还报告，在 Qwen3-235B-A22B 与 Claude Sonnet 3.7 上，相比此前的 MCTS 对照方法减少约 15% 的 token 使用。将 2.4K 条 RPM-MCTS 样本与 170K 条基础数据混合微调 Doubao-1.5-pro-32K 后，五个下游基准的报告提升为 0.9 至 4.9 个点。这些结果支持该方法在已测试搜索与训练配置下的效用，但不能验证每个检索类比、反思后保留的前缀或蒸馏样本。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior MCTS code-generation systems commonly rely on outcome rewards, LLM self-evaluation, a trained process reward model, or post-hoc code patching. RPM-MCTS instead uses a retrievable bank of correct algorithmic-step prefixes as a process-level prior, combines it with UCB for node selection, filters semantically redundant expansions, and feeds execution-guided error localization back into the tree. The contribution is this integration and its explicit step-level search trace, not MCTS, retrieval, execution feedback, or supervised distillation individually. For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data category, the direction signal is the proposed linkage among source problem, step node, retrieved neighbors and score, pruning outcome, sandbox/LLM feedback, correction boundary, backed-up value, and selected trajectory. The paper demonstrates that such trajectories can seed SFT, but the absence of a linked release prevents treating the 2.4K set as an available data resource.

既有的 MCTS 代码生成系统通常依赖结果奖励、LLM 自评、训练得到的过程奖励模型，或事后代码修补。RPM-MCTS 则把可检索的正确算法步骤前缀库作为过程级先验，将其与 UCB 组合用于节点选择，过滤语义重复的扩展，并把执行引导的错误定位反馈回搜索树。其贡献在于这种集成方式及显式的步骤级搜索轨迹，而不是单独发明 MCTS、检索、执行反馈或监督蒸馏。对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 类别，方向性信号在于它提出关联源问题、步骤节点、检索邻居与得分、剪枝结果、沙箱/LLM 反馈、纠错边界、回传价值和最终轨迹。论文证明这类轨迹可以用于 SFT，但由于没有链接公开发布，不能把 2.4K 数据视为现成可用的数据资源。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Retrieval similarity is only a heuristic: the paper observes that textually similar but logically different solutions can inject noise, particularly on simpler tasks. Public tests cover only part of program behavior, while the LLM judge can share errors with the generator; their weighted score is therefore neither a formal verifier nor a guarantee that retained prefixes are correct. Error localization and truncation may preserve an earlier hidden mistake, and similarity filtering may remove a useful alternative. The stepwise representation can also expand code that could be written in one line into multiple lines, the limitation explicitly noted by the authors.

Reproducibility and data audit are further limited by the lack of linked code, knowledge-base contents, retrieval neighbors, full trees, rejected candidates, reward logs, sandbox image/version, model prompts and revisions, seeds, or the 2.4K distilled dataset. Source-level licensing, split policy, contamination against evaluation benchmarks, and the effect of mixing 2.4K generated records with 170K foundational records are not disclosed at record level. Benchmark and fine-tuning improvements therefore should not be interpreted as proof of trace correctness, release completeness, or data cleanliness.

检索相似度只是一种启发式信号：论文观察到，文本相似但逻辑解法不同的历史案例会引入噪声，尤其是在较简单任务上。公开测试只能覆盖部分程序行为，而 LLM judge 可能与生成器共享错误；二者的加权得分既不是形式化 verifier，也不能保证被保留前缀正确。错误定位与截断可能保留更早出现的隐蔽错误，相似度过滤也可能删除有用的替代路径。作者还明确指出，步骤化表示可能把本可一行完成的代码展开为多行。

由于没有链接代码、知识库内容、检索邻居、完整搜索树、被拒候选、奖励日志、沙箱镜像/版本、模型提示与版本、随机种子或 2.4K 蒸馏数据，复现和数据审计进一步受限。源级许可、划分策略、与评测基准的污染情况，以及 2.4K 生成记录与 170K 基础记录混合后的独立作用，均未在逐记录层面披露。因此，基准和微调提升不能被解释为轨迹正确性、发布完整性或数据洁净度的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, RPM-MCTS is useful as a schema and construction recipe for recording how test-time search turns candidate algorithmic steps into a selected code solution. A reusable trace should preserve the source problem and split, knowledge-base revision and retrieved record IDs, every candidate node, embeddings or similarity scores, pruning decisions, UCB and backed-up values, generated code, public-test outputs, LLM judgments, reflection text, error boundary, retained prefix, final path, token cost, and all model and sandbox revisions. Such traces could support search-policy analysis, verifier calibration, failure auditing, compute-efficiency studies, or SFT after an independent quality filter. The paper’s 2.4K experiment establishes a possible training use, not an available dataset or a general guarantee that MCTS-selected traces are suitable for post-training.

对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 轨道，RPM-MCTS 可作为一种模式与构造配方，用于记录测试时搜索如何把候选算法步骤转化为最终选中的代码解答。可复用轨迹应保留源问题及划分、知识库版本与检索记录 ID、全部候选节点、嵌入或相似度得分、剪枝决策、UCB 与回传价值、生成代码、公开测试输出、LLM 判断、反思文本、错误边界、保留前缀、最终路径、token 成本，以及全部模型与沙箱版本。经过独立质量过滤后，这类轨迹可用于搜索策略分析、verifier 校准、失败审计、计算效率研究或 SFT。论文中的 2.4K 实验只说明一种可能的训练用途，并不意味着数据集已经公开，也不能普遍保证 MCTS 选中轨迹适合后训练。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Verify whether an official code, knowledge-base, tree-log, or 2.4K-data release has appeared before claiming reproducibility or availability.
  • Audit retrieval neighbors for textual similarity without algorithmic equivalence, and report results separately by task difficulty.
  • Replay public-test execution in a pinned sandbox and independently test whether each retained prefix precedes the first actual error.
  • Separate retrieval-as-PRM scores, LLM judgments, execution rewards, and MCTS selection values in any exported trace.
  • Treat pass@1, token savings, and downstream fine-tuning gains as system-level evidence, not record-level proof of data quality.

• 在声称可复现或可获得之前，核查是否已出现官方代码、知识库、搜索树日志或 2.4K 数据发布。
  • 审计检索邻居是否仅文本相似而算法逻辑不等价，并按任务难度分别报告结果。
  • 在固定版本的沙箱中重放公开测试，并独立检查每个保留前缀是否确实位于首个实际错误之前。
  • 导出轨迹时，分别保存 retrieval-as-PRM 得分、LLM 判断、执行奖励和 MCTS 选择价值。
  • 将 pass@1、token 节省和下游微调提升视为系统级证据，而不是逐记录数据质量证明。
